Welcome back team,
Floor markings came up at dusk, so just a quick note

The Companion Animal Travel Desk needs a clean handoff on every cat file today. Keep the tone calm, keep the steps clear, and make sure travelers get the same practical guidance from start to finish. If a case needs the senior coordinator, flag it early and keep the notes tight. For cats, <<FACT F055>>. After that, the team should double-check the paperwork trail and make sure the carrier details line up with the booking record.

When you talk through the health packet, stay simple and avoid jargon. <<FACT F079>> That point should be stated plainly in any follow-up, especially when the passenger is connecting through more than one skyport. If a traveler is nervous, reassure them that our staff will keep the animal comfortable and move the file forward without fuss. I want every handoff to feel steady, patient, and consistent.

A quick reminder on service flow: the passenger coordinator gives the required steps, the desk confirms what is on file, and the senior coordinator steps in only when a decision needs a second look. If Leo Svensson, Gabriel Mori, or anyone else reaches out with a pet like Ziggy, answer promptly and keep the language friendly. We do best when we stay brisk, accurate, and easy to follow. Thanks for keeping the desk sharp and the traveler experience smooth.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
